cards.ex: When the masked man pulled out a knife, I was quaking in my shoes.
cards.exUz: Maskali odam pichoq chiqarganida, men qattiq qo'rqib ketdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq qo'rqish, vahimaga tushish, o'zini yo'qotib qo'yish.

cards.ex: The sudden loud bang scared me witless.
cards.exUz: To'satdan qattiq portlash meni juda qo'rqitib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli qo'rqinchdan aqlini yo'qotib qo'yish darajasiga yetish.

cards.ex: He threw a wobbly when he found out his flight was cancelled.
cards.exUz: U parvozi bekor qilinganini bilib, asabiylashdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda asabiylashish, jahli chiqib ketish, o'zini tuta olmaslik.

cards.ex: Beneath his calm exterior was a simmering rage waiting to explode.
cards.exUz: Uning xotirjam tashqi ko'rinishi ostida portlashga tayyor yashirin g'azab bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Ichida qaynab yotgan, lekin tashqariga chiqmay turgan kuchli g'azab.

cards.ex: I was at a loss for words when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men bu yangilikni eshitganimda, nima deyishga hayron qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Hayratdan yoki shokka tushganidan nima deyishni bilmay qolish.

cards.ex: My mom will have kittens if I'm late again.
cards.exUz: Agar men yana kech qolsam, onam juda xavotirlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda asabiylashish, xavotirlanish, qo'rqishdan o'zini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: The refugees are in dire straits and desperately need assistance.
cards.exUz: Qochqinlar juda og'ir ahvolda va yordamga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Juda og'ir, xavfli, qiyin ahvolda bo'lish, yordamga muhtojlik.

cards.ex: She was beside herself with grief after her cat died.
cards.exUz: Mushugi o'lganidan keyin u qayg'udan o'zini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan juda hayajonlanish, xursand bo'lish yoki g'azablanish.

cards.ex: A bone-chilling fear gripped her as she walked through the dark forest.
cards.exUz: Qorong'u o'rmondan o'tayotganda uni muzlatuvchi qo'rquv qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, tanani muzlatib yuboradigan qo'rquv hissi.

cards.ex: The community is up in arms over the proposed new highway.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat taklif qilingan yangi avtomobil yo'liga qarshi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir juda g'azablanib, norozilik bildirish, qarshi kurashish.

cards.ex: The news of his death was a bolt from the blue.
cards.exUz: Uning o'limi haqidagi xabar kutilmagan zarba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va yoqimsiz hodisa, zarba, ajablanarli yangilik.

cards.ex: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the exam results.
cards.exUz: Biz imtihon natijalarini xavotirlik bilan kutdik.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir juda xavotirlanib, sabrsizlik bilan kutish, tashvishlanish.

cards.ex: A wave of panic swept through the crowd when the fire alarm went off.
cards.exUz: Yong'in signalizatsiyasi ishga tushganda olomonni vahima to'lqini qamrab oldi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'ladigan va tez tarqaladigan kuchli vahima hissi.

cards.ex: His constant complaining is driving me up the wall.
cards.exUz: Uning doimiy shikoyatlari meni bezdirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan juda bezor qilish, asabiylashtirish, chidab bo'lmas holatga keltirish.

cards.ex: He tends to fly off the handle when he's stressed.
cards.exUz: U stressga tushganda jahli chiqib ketishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga g'azablanish, o'zini tuta olmay qolish, asabiylashish.

cards.ex: She approached the interview in a state of trepidation.
cards.exUz: U suhbatga xavotirlik holatida yaqinlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv, xavotirlik va tashvish hissi bilan to'la holat.

cards.ex: She was terrified out of her wits by the horror movie.
cards.exUz: U dahshatli filmdan aqldan ozgancha qo'rqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli qo'rquvdan aqlni yo'qotish, vahimaga tushish.

cards.ex: You look like you've seen a ghost! What's wrong?
cards.exUz: Siz go'yo arvohni ko'rgandek ko'rinasiz! Nima bo'ldi?
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib ketish, vahimaga tushish, o'zini yo'qotish.

cards.ex: He's been in a blue funk since he lost his job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri tushkunlikda.
cards.uzDef: Chuqur tushkunlik, xafagarchilik, umidsizlik holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: He bristled with anger at the accusation.
cards.exUz: U ayblovdan g'azabga to'ldi.
cards.uzDef: G'azabdan qizarish, qattiq g'azabni his qilish va ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: He developed a nervous tic during the stressful exam period.
cards.exUz: U stressli imtihon davrida nervoz tikni rivojlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Nervozlikdan kelib chiqadigan beixtiyoriy harakat yoki tovush.

cards.ex: She let out a scream when she saw the spider.
cards.exUz: U o'rgimchakni ko'rganida baqirib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rquv, og'riq yoki hayratdan baland ovozda baqirish.

cards.ex: We were aghast at the level of destruction.
cards.exUz: Biz vayronagarchilik darajasidan dahshatga tushdik.
cards.uzDef: Juda hayron qolish va qo'rqib ketish, shokka tushish.

cards.ex: She went as white as a sheet when she heard the news.
cards.exUz: U yangilikni eshitgach, yuzi oq qog'oz kabi oqarib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib ketganidan yoki kasallikdan yuzi oqarib ketgan.

cards.ex: After dealing with the difficult customer all day, I was at the end of my tether.
cards.exUz: Qiyin mijoz bilan butun kun davomida ishlaganimdan so'ng, sabrim tugadi.
cards.uzDef: Sabrning oxirgi nuqtasiga yetish, chidashga kuch qolmagan.

cards.ex: He woke up in a cold sweat after having a nightmare.
cards.exUz: U dahshatli tush ko'rib, sovuq terga botib uyg'ondi.
cards.uzDef: Nervozlik, qo'rquv yoki kasallik tufayli paydo bo'ladigan sovuq ter.

cards.ex: The eerie music sent shivers down my spine.
cards.exUz: G'alati musiqa meni titratib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqinchli bo'lish, vujudga titroq solish.

cards.ex: I had a sinking feeling that I had forgotten something important.
cards.exUz: Men muhim narsani unutganim haqida yomon his paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsa sodir bo'lishi haqida xavotirli yoki noxush his paydo bo'lish.

cards.ex: She was scared out of her mind when she heard the footsteps in the house.
cards.exUz: Uyda oyoq tovushlarini eshitgach, u aqli uchib qo'rqib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqib ketish, aqlini yo'qotish darajasiga yetish.

cards.ex: I was completely taken aback by his sudden outburst.
cards.exUz: Men uning to'satdan portlashidan butunlay hayratga tushdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir kutilmaganda hayratlanish, shokka tushish.
